strategies.overview: Blessed with the rare Fairy typing and an excellent Speed tier, Whimsicott makes for an excellent revenge killer and utility Pokemon. Whimsicott's unique typing allows it to beat many dangerous threats like Persian-Alola and Virizion. A powerful Moonblast and pivoting coupled with Choice Specs allow Whimsicott to break past bulkier threats like Orthworm and Glastrier. However, Whimsicott's low offensive stats leave it often wanting for power, especially without Choice Specs, and it's incapable of fitting every move it wants. Furthermore, lack of reliable recovery and only average bulk makes it unable to consistently check the Pokemon it's supposed to like Regirock and Sandaconda.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Psychic is an option that nails Poison-types like Weezing. However, this comes at the cost of either losing U-turn's pivoting or the utility of Switcheroo or Encore. Whimsicott can use a SubSeed set to mess up its usual defensive checks like Cryogonal and Orthworm and be a general nuisance. This set struggles to find setup opportunities however and relies heavily on getting a free Substitute on a forced switch.

Checks and Counters

Poison-types: Whimsicott's 4x weakness to Poison and inability to hit Poison-types with its STAB attacks makes Poison-types like Muk and Weezing good checks. However, these Pokemon lack reliable recovery and can thus be worn down over a game.

Steel-types: Steel-types like Magneton and Orthworm can take Whimsicott's STAB attacks with ease. Orthworm can start setting entry hazards or set up with Coil or Iron Defense, while Magneton can generate momentum with Volt Switch.

Fire-types: As Whimsicott's STAB attacks do little to them, Fire-types like Charizard, Typhlosion, and Magmortar can use Whimsicott as an entry point to start firing off powerful attacks. These Pokemon aren't usually defensively invested however and can struggle to switch in consistently.

Special Walls: Special walls like Cryogonal and Articuno aren't bothered by Whimsicott's attacks and can use it to start forcing progress with entry hazards, status, pivoting, or boosts. However, Switcheroo completely ruins these walls, especially Articuno, and Encore can force them to repeat their status moves, allowing Whimsicott to safely bring in a teammate.

Choice Scarf Users: Many common Choice Scarf users like Hisuian Sneasel and Gunk Shot Primeape get the jump on Whimsicott and can easily take it out.

movesets.name: Choice Specs
movesets.description:
Choice Specs Whimsicott takes advantage of its high Speed and Moonblast to be a powerful cleaner and revenge killer. U-turn lets It scout for switches and pivot out of unfavorable matchups like Weezing and Orthworm, allowing it to bring in a more suitable teammate. Switcheroo allows Whimsicott to cripple its defensive checks, greatly hindering special walls like Orthworm and especially Articuno, letting Whimsicott and its teammates break past them later in the game. However, Whimsicott loses a substantial amount of power without its Choice Specs, so one must be careful about when to use Switcheroo. Infiltrator allows Whimsicott to bypass Substitute from foes like Glastrier and opposing Whimsicott.

Choice Specs Whimsicott best fits on balance and bulky offense teams looking for a fast offensive cleaner that also provides some defensive utility. Whimsicott loves entry-hazard stacking teammates like Sandslash and Orthworm to help push its otherwise average damage output. It can't handle Fire-types like Charizard and Typhlosion, so answers to them like Regirock and Naclstack help immensely. Whimsicott can in return take advantage of the Grass- and Fighting-types like Virizion and Primeape that these Pokemon are at a disadvantage against. Whimsicott struggles with Poison-types like Weezing and Muk who resist its STAB attacks and threathen it with 4x super effective attacks, so answers like Magneton and Sandaconda make for great teammates. Whimsicott pairs well with offensive Fire-types like Typhlosion and Charizard that handle the Steel-types like Orthworm that it has difficulties breaking past, and in return, it handles their Water and Rock-type answers such as Clawitzer and Regirock.

movesets.name: Offensive Pivot
movesets.description:
Whimsicott leverages its superb Speed and access to Prankster to be a competent offensive pivot. Giga Drain is used for its ability to give Whimsicott staying power in longer games. Encore is key to this set, allowing it to force defensive foes into unfavorable moves like Stealth Rock and Recover, as well as shutting down setup sweepers like Jolteon and Regirock by locking them into their setup moves. U-turn pairs beautifully with Encore, scouting any forced switches and allowing Whimsicott to bring in powerful teammates like Glastrier and Typhlosion. Tera Steel gives Whimsicott an immunity to Poison-type attacks from Muk and Weezing, and a resistance to Flying-type attacks from Dodrio as well as Ice-type attacks from Sneasel in a pinch. However, this still leaves Whimsicott vulnerable to Fire-type attacks from Charizard and Typhlosion and makes it weak to Fighting, making it unable to reliably switch into Primeape and Virizion. Tera Fire provides emergency resistances to Ice and Fire, but this makes Whimsicott unable to safely check Ground- and Rock-types like Sandaconda and Regirock.

Balance teams enjoy Whimsicott's pivoting and Prankster Encore helping them deal with bulky defensive Pokemon and dangerous setup sweepers. Powerful physical wallbreakers like Glastrier and Primeape pair well with Whimsicott, as it baits in special walls like Articuno and can bring these teammates in with U-turn. Ground-types like Sandaconda make for excellent partners, as Whimsicott helps them handle the Water- and Grass-types like Clawitzer and Virizion that they struggle with, while they can handle Poison-types like Muk that scare Whimsicott out. Fire-types like Charizard and Magmortar can easily gain entry on Whimsicott, so Fire-resistant teammates like Regirock and Naclstack are helpful partners. Partners such as Charizard or Primeape that threaten Steel-types like Orthworm and Magneton can come in after a U-turn on these Steel-types to fire off attacks. Electric-types like Jolteon and Magneton appreciate Whimsicott's ability to handle Ground-types like Sandaconda, and in return, they handle the Flying-types like Dodrio and Articuno that Whimsicott struggles to beat. Other offensive pivots like Primeape and Mesprit can form a powerful VoltTurn core with Whimsicott, quickly racking up damage against walls like Regirock and Muk, especially with entry hazards up.

movesets.name: Pivot Support
movesets.description: Whimsicott can be used to check some of the tier's most powerful physical attackers in Flygon, Tauros-Paldea-Aqua, and Breloom. Moonblast is its most reliable attacking option, U-turn allows Whimsicott to pivot out of bad matchups, and Prankster Encore serves as a blanket check to setup sweepers. Giga Drain offers a form of recovery and hits Water-types like Vaporeon and Swampert while Memento paves the way for Whimsicott's teammates to set up for a sweep of their own and Leech Seed lets Whimsicott bother bulky switch-ins like Copperajah, Bronzong, and Galarian Slowbro. 68 Speed EVs allows Whimsicott to outpace Chandelure.

movesets.name: Choice Specs
movesets.description:
Shadow Ball threatens Delphox and Bronzong and hits Alolan Sandslash slightly harder than Moonblast. Pranskter should only be used alongside Switcheroo, since this makes the move better at disrupting teams.

Sample set. Stay tuned for updates!

strategies.overview:
Grass

Whimsicott finds niches with its Fairy typing, allowing it to take on Dragon-types, along with Prankster boosting its great utility movepool such as Encore, which enables it to lock targets like Dragonite and Skarmory into undesirable moves. However, Whimsicott's low stats outside of Speed leave much to be desired in terms of power, and its utility movepool can often be stifled by opposing Grass-types and bulky Dark-types such as Ogerpon-H and Alolan Muk, which will happily remove it.

movesets.name: Offensive Disruptor (Grass)
movesets.description:
Whimsicott finds a niche on Grass with its Fairy typing and vast support movepool boosted by Prankster to act as a disruptor against threats such as Dragonite and Volcarona. Encore allows Whimsicott to lock otherwise game-winning sweepers like Victory Dance Hisuian Lilligant and Dragon Dance Dragapult into their setup options, enabling Whimsicott or its teammates to remove them. Moonblast provides a form of offense for Whimsicott, allowing it to threaten Dragon- and Dark-type threats such as Archaludon, Roaring Moon, and Sableye. Stun Spore grants Whimiscott a vital form of speed control, slowing down foes like Sneasler and Dragapult. Alternatively, Tailwind provides long term speed control and is useful to use before Whimsicott is KOed. Heavy-Duty Boots allows Whimsicott to safely enter the field, while Pixie Plate enables it to 2HKO Archaludon.

Ogerpon-H serves as a vital ally, being able to handle Poison- and Steel-types that beat Whimsicott such as Alolan Muk, Amoonguss, Heatran, and Gholdengo. Ogerpon-H also appreciates Whimiscott paralyzing Sneasler and Tornadus-T so it can check them. Alternatively, Ogerpon-C can be used to nail Fire- and Flying-types such as Ninetales and Ogerpon-H that cause Whimsicott trouble while also appreciating Tailwind to outspeed +1 Volcarona and Meowscarada with a Speed boost from Protosynthesis. Choice Scarf Meowscarada provides an incredible form of speed control, being able to check threats such as Choice Specs Flutter Mane and Choice Scarf Gholdengo that cause Whimsicott issues; it also benefits from Stun Spore, enabling it to outspeed Choice Scarf Dragapult. Amoonguss provides a solid defensive pivot for Whimsicott, as it can absorb Toxic Spikes should Whimsicott opt for Pixie Plate along with using Foul Play on a setup threat such as Swords Dance Ceruledge to remove it once hit with Encore. Amoonguss can also use Sludge Bomb to take on Fairy-types like Hatterene that can deflect Whimsicott's utility via Magic Bounce. Hisuian Lilligant and Breloom appreciate Whimsicott's Encore, granting safe setup opportunities and can use their Fighting-type STAB moves to deal with Ice- and Steel-types such as Kyurem, Alolan Sandslash, and Hisuian Goodra in return. Hydrapple appreciates Whimsicott removing Dragon-types like Roaring Moon and Raging Bolt and, in return, can use its Fire neutrality and Earth Power to take on Fire-types like Heatran, Hisuian Arcanine, and Iron Moth. Sinistcha similarly provides a Fire neutrality along with a Poison neutrality, enabling it to take on threats such as Sneasler, Clodsire, and Toxapex with Calm Mind and Strength Sap.

movesets.name: Tailwind Support
movesets.description: • This EV Spread outspeeds Timid Glimmora and neutral nature Base 100s such as Chi-Yu.

movesets.name: Focus Sash Support
movesets.description: • This set is more useful for Beat Up support, however if Moonblast is chosen, 36 HP / 220 SpA / 252 Spe can be used to OHKO Chien-Pao with Moonblast.

strategies.overview:
• Whimsicott's combination of a good supportive movepool, great Fairy typing allowing it to threaten Pokemon like both Urishifu formes, and Prankster makes it a good utility Pokemon in Regulation F.

  • Whimsicott enjoys fast threats like Flutter Mane, Urshifu formes, and Landorus, which can exploit its Tailwind

  • Whimsicott also can use Beat Up to form a niche but lethal combination with Pokemon like Terrakion.

  • Whimsicott struggles against faster Pokemon with super effective STAB moves like Tornadus and Chien-Pao, so Pokemon who can deal with these two like Flutter Mane and Raging Bolt are helpful to have.

movesets.name: Sun Setter
movesets.description:
• Moonblast keeps Whimsicott from being passive and hits threats like Raging Bolt and Urshifu-S for super effective damage.

  • Whimsicott can opt for Beat Up instead, allowing it to trigger Annihilape's Rage Fist and Terrakion's Justified ability.

  • Sunny Day activates Pokemon like Flutter Mane and Raging Bolts's abilities, making them more potent threats, as well as weakening Urshifu-R and Ogerpon-W.

  • The fourth move slot is customizable; Fake Tears allows Whimsicott to weaken Pokemon for partners like Flutter Mane and Landorus, Encore locks foes into unfavorable moves like Protect and Fake Out, Taunt helps shut down more passive Pokemon like Amoonguss and opposing Whimsicott.

  • The EV spread allows Whimsicott to live Tornadus's Bleakwind Storm and outspeed Maximum Speed Tornadus.

  • Tera Water grants Whimsicott valuable resistances to Fire-, Ice-, and Steel-types like Incineroar, Chien-Pao, and Kingambit while generally being a great defensive typing.

  • Covert Cloak allows Whimsicott to be immune to Fake Out.

movesets.name: Offensive Utility
movesets.description:
• Protect is valuable for dealing with Fake Out, but it does not allow fitting Sunny Day.

  • Tera Ghost makes Whimsicott immune to common priority moves like Fake Out and Extreme Speed as well as providing a resistance to Poison-type moves like Landorus' Sludge Bomb.

  • Focus Sash allows Whimsicott to have another chance to set up Tailwind or support its team later on in the game, as its mediocre defensive stats and plethora of weaknesses otherwise leave it potentially OHKOd by most Pokemon in the metagame.

  • Note that if Whimsicott is running Beat Up, an EV spread of 252 HP / 4 Def / 252 Spe with a Jolly Nature is more optimal.

movesets.name: Covert Cloak
movesets.description:
Whimsicott is a potent Tailwind setter in the Regulation G metagame thanks to Prankster in conjunction with its good supporting movepool, and its typing lets it take on staples such as Raging Bolt and both Urshifu formes. Moonblast lets Whimsicott consistently damage bulky Pokemon such as the aforementioned Raging Bolt while also chipping down Rillaboom and Incineroar. It also lets Whimsicott take full advantage of its good matchup against both Urshifu formes, threatening Urshifu-R with a 2HKO and Urshifu-S with an OHKO once its Focus Sash is broken. Whimsicott's ability to punish passive play like Protect via Encore allows fast-paced teammates like Choice Specs Miraidon and Choice Scarf Chi-Yu to safely output huge damage. Encore also has other immensely useful applications like forcing non-Dark-type Fake Out users like Rillaboom and Iron Hands to switch out if they choose to use the move and reversing Trick Room in the face of threats such as Calyrex-I; this is crucial, as Tailwind teams inherently struggle against Trick Room, especially when they have multiple Pokemon weak to the aforementioned Calyrex-I. Light Screen helps bolster Whimsicott and its allies' bulk against threats such as Calyrex-S and Choice Specs Terapagos. Covert Cloak lets Whimsicott safely ignore Fake Out and set up Tailwind, allowing it to threaten with Encore on the following turn. The physical bulk investment allows Whimsicott to avoid an OHKO from -1 Zamazenta-C's Heavy Slam while never being 2HKOed by +1 Body Press. The special bulk investment enables Whimsicott to never be OHKOed by Choice Specs Tera Stellar Terapagos-S's Tera Starstorm and Mystic Water Kyogre's Water Spout in rain even at full power. Maximum Speed is run in order to let Whimsicott have the best chance to force opposing Whimsicott to repeatedly use Tailwind with Encore, which is an interaction that can also be put to use against the slower Tornadus. Tera Fire rids Whimsicott of its weakness to Chien-Pao's Icicle Crash and Incineroar's Flare Blitz among other powerful moves like Calyrex-I's Glacial Lance and Koraidon's sun-boosted Flare Blitz, crucially never getting 2HKOed by Glacial Lance. Alternatively, Tera Water lets it retain its initial resistance to Kyogre's Water Spout and Origin Pulse in addition to the resistances provided by Tera Fire in exchange for sacrificing the positive defensive matchup against Rillaboom and Raging Bolt. Tera Water also provides Whimsicott with a better matchup against Calyrex-I and Pelipper.

Whimsicott, being rather frail, is vulnerable to many relevant Pokemon, most notably Tornadus, as not only does it compete with Whimsicott as a Prankster Tailwind user on nearly every team apart from Miraidon hyper offense, but it also threatens an OHKO with Bleakwind Storm because Whimsicott lacks a Focus Sash. Thus, Miraidon makes for a good partner, as it can easily OHKO Tornadus. Whimsicott supports Choice Specs Miraidon exceptionally well, letting it dish out massive amounts of damage with Tera Electric uncontested under Tailwind. Encore punishes opposing Fake Out users, allowing Choice Specs Miraidon to stay on the field more safely. Whimsicott also helps Chi-Yu do great amounts of damage onto foes thanks to Tailwind and checks Raging Bolt for both it and Miraidon thanks to Beads of Ruin; this is of great value, as Miraidon is otherwise forced to lock into Draco Meteor. Whimsicott is susceptible to being removed by faster Pokemon like Calyrex-I under Trick Room and Chien-Pao, so you should be wise with managing its health and speed control. Iron Hands allows this to happen quite well, not only taking advantage of Trick Room with its low Speed but also heavily threatening Chien-Pao. Its good bulk, access to Fake Out, and healing from Drain Punch allow it to keep Whimsicott safe for multiple turns.

movesets.name: Focus Sash
movesets.description:
Whimsicott is an excellent Tailwind setter with a deep support movepool, mainly setting itself apart from Tornadus with its higher Speed, access to Encore and Helping Hand, and useful typing that gives it defensive utility against staples like Miraidon, Kyogre, Rillaboom, Raging Bolt, and both Urshifu formes. Moonblast provides a reliable STAB move that lets Whimsicott deal solid damage to common Fairy-weak Pokemon like Miraidon, Koraidon, Chien-Pao, and the Urshifu formes. Encore is Whimsicott's most infamous support option, letting it punish setup sweepers like Calm Mind Terapagos, IronPress Zamazenta-C, and Nasty Plot Calyrex-S for attempting to boost in front of it; the move also punishes foes from trying to stall out Tailwind turns with Protect, and it discourages Rillaboom from using Fake Out lest it be locked into it. Additionally, it forces Trick Room setters like Calyrex-I to untwist the dimensions. Taunt is a similarly useful disruption tool that can be used with or in place of Encore, notably allowing Whimsicott to deny Tailwind from other setters like Tornadus and Lunala unless they use Tera Dark. Protect helps Whimsicott keep itself on the field and stay in a position to use its other moves repeatedly, especially in the face of Fake Out users, but the last moveslot can also be spent on more aggressive options like Helping Hand, which is useful with any attacker, or Fake Tears, which is especially devastating alongside strong special threats like Chi-Yu. Whimsicott enjoys holding a Focus Sash to make up for its poor bulk, and Tera Ghost is useful to prevent the item from being wasted by Fake Out.

Whimsicott's reliable Tailwind support is a blessing to almost every Restricted Pokemon, especially those with middling Speed tiers such as Groudon and Terapagos, as well as Pokemon that want to be faster against opposing Tailwind teams such as Miraidon and Calyrex-S. All four of those Pokemon also benefit from Encore, which can create space for them to set up with Swords Dance, Nasty Plot, and Calm Mind. Clear Amulet Koraidon is another notable partner that reliably discourages opponents from bringing Incineroar, which is easily the worst Pokemon for Whimsicott to face in a battle. Other strong attackers that benefit from Tailwind support are also great with it; Landorus and Urshifu-S both fall into this category, and Chi-Yu is a standout example because it augments Whimsicott's modest damage output with Beads of Ruin. Other setup Pokemon that enjoy Encore are especially useful to justify using Whimsicott on a team over Tornadus, including Calm Mind Raging Bolt, Swords Dance Ogerpon-H, and Nasty Plot Gholdengo. It's important to make sure Whimsicott has teammates that can deal with problematic Dark-types like Chi-Yu, Ting-Lu, and Kingambit due to their Prankster immunity, and a Fighting-type like Urshifu-R or Iron Hands can help with that significantly.

movesets.name: Tailwind Support
movesets.description:
Set Details

  • Whimsicott uses its toolkit of support moves and solid defensive typing to aid its team. Prankster allows Whimsicott to get off Tailwind and Encore consistently. It can shrug off strong attacks like Close Combat from both Urshifu formes and return considerable damage to them with Moonblast. It also threatens heavy damage into Koraidon.
  • Encore can punish moves such as Fake Out, Calm Mind, and Protect. Light Screen helps Whimsicott's team survive powerful attacks such as Astral Barrage from Calyrex-S, Electro Drift and Draco Meteor from Miraidon, and Moongeist Beam and Meteor Beam from Lunala.
  • Covert Cloak prevents Fake Out from stopping Whimsicott from supporting its team.
  • The Speed investment allows Whimsicott to always outspeed Tornadus. The special bulk investment allows it to almost always survive Astral Barrage from Tera Ghost Calyrex-S and Electro Drift from Choice Specs Miraidon. Dazzling Gleam from Choice Specs Tera Fairy Miraidon will never OHKO Whimsicott. It also survives Tera Starstorm from +1 Special Attack Terapagos and +1 Meteor Beam from Lunala.
  • Tera Dark stops Prankster Encore and Taunt from opposing Whimsicott or Tornadus from disrupting Whimsicott's support moves. It also serves as a good defensive typing into Calyrex-S and Lunala.

Teambuilding

  • Whimsicott is not strong into opposing Trick Room, as Tailwind would be detrimental and Trick Room setters like Calyrex-I and Lunala can switch out before being targeted by Encore. Farigiraf's Armor Tail and Indeedee-F's Psychic Terrain shut down Encore, which also prevents Whimsicott from punishing things like Protect and Trick Room.
  • Koraidon can threaten an OHKO with Flare Blitz or Flame Charge onto Whimsicott, and Tera Fire keeps Koraidon safe from Moonblast. Galarian Weezing prevents priority Tailwind from being set up thanks to Neutralizing Gas. Incineroar also threatens an OHKO with Flare Blitz, can use Knock Off to remove Covert Cloak to use Fake Out later, and cannot be disrupted by Encore. Zamazenta-C can OHKO Whimsicott without being threatened by it.
  • Miraidon, Lunala, and the Urshifu formes appreciate Tailwind allowing them to outspeed foes such as Calyrex-S, Flutter Mane, and Chien-Pao. Lunala in particular appreciates Whimsicott's Moonblast pressuring opposing Dark-types such as Chien-Pao and Urshifu-S. Lunala also likes the presence of Tailwind combined with its Trick Room to force the opponent to cover for both speed modes. Miraidon, in return for Whimsicott's support, threatens Flying-types Whimsicott is weak to such as Tornadus and Ho-Oh. Both Urshifu formes help Whimsicott by beating Incineroar, and Urshifu-S can OHKO Indeedee-F and Farigiraf.
  • The combination of Fake Out from Pokemon like Iron Hands and Incineroar with Encore can punish Protect if it is used to avoid Fake Out. Foes are deterred from using Protect to scout what Choice Specs Miraidon will lock itself into due to the pressure exerted by Encore. Choice Specs Miraidon can also threaten heavy damage or an OHKO into Galarian Weezing and Koraidon even when Hadron Engine is not active. Miraidon also helps the threat of Encore stay active, as it can OHKO Indeedee-F and Farigiraf when Electric Terrain is on the field.

strategies.comments:
Teambuilding

  • Whimsicott generally works well on hyper offensive teams that appreciate its ability to provide speed control and shut down opposing setup threats with Encore. Pokemon that have middling or high Speed tiers and strong offenses pair especially well with Whimsicott. Whimsicott can also work well on sun-centric teams, utilizing its ability to overwrite Pelipper's Drizzle with Sunny Day to maintain speed and weather control.

  • Whimsicott pairs especially well with strong special attackers, namely Hisuian Typhlosion, Glimmora, Power Herb Archaludon, Gholdengo, and Garchomp. Their middling Speed tiers benefit greatly from Tailwind, and Hisuian Typhlosion in particular also appreciates Whimsicott's ability to set sun, boosting its Eruption further while mitigating its Water weakness. Annihilape can be used on some teams that want to employ Beat Up strategies, which can also be effective.

  • Whimsicott can struggle into teams that can handle its partner's offensive onslaught or mitigate Whimsicott's Tailwind Speed advantage. However, by changing up Whimsicott's partner, it can break through some defensive cores that may stop one pairing but not the other. For example, while Incineroar may be able to beat Whimsicott and Hisuian Typhlosion, it loses to Meteor Beam Glimmora. Since Whimsicott generally pairs with strong, fast offensive threats, its playstyle is very vunerable to Trick Room, especially teams that have Psychic Terrain, which blocks Whimsicott's Prankster Encore. Due to this, Whimsicott generally likes to pair with Incineroar to shut down Trick Room teams while also allowing Whimsicott's frailer partners to pivot in safely.

Strategy Comments

  • Whimsicott exists as a support Pokemon, providing speed control through Prankster Tailwind and amplifying its partner's damage output through Helping Hand or Sunny Day.
  • Whimsicott is almost always a lead Pokemon, with a hard-hitting partner that takes advantage of its Tailwind support. It almost always wants to be clicking Tailwind to gain the Speed advantage immediately, unless it is facing a Trick Room team that can turn that advantage on its head. Against bulkier cores that may not have speed control or care about moving first, Whimsicott may choose to use Helping Hand or Sunny Day to try to break through those cores with its partner's sheer power.
  • Whimsicott is mainly weak to strong priority that can take it out before it can set Tailwind, mainly Tera Normal Extreme Speed from Dragonite and Brave Bird from Talonflame. Pokemon that can stomach many hits and slow down the level of offense coming from Whimsicott's side can also be a problem, since Whimsicott is so frail that it can usually only afford to set Tailwind or Sunny Day once. By choosing certain partners for Whimsicott, this matchup problem can be turned on its head. Pokemon such as Glimmora can beat common counters to Whimsicott, including Talonflame, Dragonite, and Incineroar. Pokemon that block priority moves can also support Whimsicott, such as Indeedee with Psychic Terrain and Farigiraf with Armor Tail.

movesets.name: Tailwind Support
movesets.description:
• Whimsicott is a staple on hyper offense teams due to its ability to set Tailwind with its Prankster ability. Whimsicott also provides valuable support to its team through the use of Encore to disrupt opposing strategies or Helping Hand and Sunny Day to boost its partner's damage output.
  • Encore is generally preferred to be able to pin opposing Pokemon into positions where they cannot use Protect, dissuade setup, and lock opposing Pokemon into moves such as Fake Out or Tailwind. Helping Hand is the preferred last move on Whimsicott for most teams because it provides a damage boost to any of Whimsicott's partners. Sunny Day is used on certain hyper offense teams to boost Hisuian Typhlosion's Eruption and provide weather control against Pelipper. Protect is almost always used on Focus Sash sets to block Fake Out without the need to Terastallize into a Ghost-type. Beat Up is specifically used with Annihilape to boost its Rage Fist; this, in conjunction with Tailwind, makes it into a threat as quickly as possible.
  • Covert Cloak is generally preferred on Whimsicott to block the effects of Fake Out, allowing Whimsicott to get Tailwind off without having to run Protect. However, Focus Sash is sometimes used on teams that want Whimsicott's support on the field for longer. Focus Sash also allows Whimsicott to set Tailwind in front of Talonflame, which would otherwise KO Whimsicott before it can set Tailwind with Brave Bird in conjunction with Gale Wings.
  • Tera Water can be used to give Covert Cloak Whimsicott an extra turn on the field against common Pokemon such as Incineroar, Hisuian Typhlosion, and Gholdengo, though it must watch out for Rillaboom's now supereffective priority Grassy Glide. Tera Ghost gives Whimsicott an immunity to common priority moves, namely Fake Out and Extreme Speed and is usually seen on Focus Sash sets, as they are susceptible to Fake Out. Tera Fire offers similar defensive benefits to Tera Water while still resisting Rillaboom's Grassy Glide after Terastallization. However, Tera Fire makes Whimsicott weak to common moves such a as Primarina's Liquid Voice Hyper Voice and Pelipper's Weather Ball under rain. Tera Dark is a niche option on Focus Sash sets that gives Whimsicott an immunity to opposing Prankster moves from the likes of Murkrow and opposing Whimsicott.
  • The first spread for Covert Cloak Whimsicott maximizes HP investment over damage output to live attacks that would otherwise prevent it from setting Tailwind. Focus Sash sets, on the other hand, invest more into Special Attack.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 6 onwards

Price Range: 7-8 points

Overview: Whimsicott is a low-tier Pokemon that makes use of Prankster to help support its teammates. It has access to a good amount of support moves that benefit from it, with the most notable being Encore, which allows it to stop setup from foes, which can be valuable in a fast-paced match. Additionally, Whimsicott's Grass / Fairy typing allows it to have a defensive niche, but factoring in its frail defensives and weaknesses can make it difficult to use defensively. Given that Whimsicott is generally not offensively strong, it can become deadweight in matches where its supporting tools aren't necessary, which makes its reliability dependent on the matchup.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Utility: Whimsicott's Prankster allows it to utilize its support moves to its greatest potential. Moves such as Encore, Stun Spore, and Switcheroo allow it to disrupt the opponent's Pokemon from setting up, while other moves such as U-turn, Tailwind, and Light Screen allow it to support its teammates. It can even annoy foes by itself with Leech Seed alongside Substitute + Protect to chip them down gradually.

Offensive Utility: Despite Whimsicott's weak offenses, its STAB moves and high Speed allow it to hit a good amount of Pokemon super effectively, function as a revenge killer, and generate momentum with U-turn. By using Choice Specs or damage-boosting items, it can become stronger offensively, allowing it to secure KOs.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Moonblast, Energy Ball, Giga Drain, Grass Knot

Setup Moves: Small cotton baby.

Utility Moves: Encore, Memento, Leech Seed, Switcheroo, Stun Spore, Taunt, U-turn, Tailwind, Substitute, Protect, Light Screen

Coverage: Psychic, Hurricane, Shadow Ball

Niche Moves

Worry Seed: Worry Seed can remove abilities from the opponent's Pokemon that can be troublesome to deal with.

Endeavor: Endeavor is good on Focus Sash or Substitute sets to wear the opponent's Pokemon down quickly.

Sunny Day: Sunny Day with Prankster can allow Whimsicott to support its teammate that appreciate sun or counter opposing weather.

Cotton Guard: Cotton Guard can help increase Whimsicott's Defense greatly, which can allow it to be more durable and difficult for foes to take out on the physical side.

Common Items

Heavy-Duty Boots: Heavy-Duty Boots gives Whimsicott protection from entry hazards, which allows it to tank attacks better.

Leftovers: Leftovers allows Whimsicott to have longevity alongside its other healing moves. It pairs well with Substitute + Leech Seed sets that keep it healthy.

Niche Items

Switcheroo Items: Items such as Sticky Barb, Lagging Tail, and Choice Scarf allow Whimsicott to cripple an opposing Pokemon thanks to Switcheroo.

Sitrus Berry: Sitrus Berry gives Whimsicott immediate recovery that can allow it to be more useful on fast-paced teams.

Resistance Berries: Resistance Berries can allow Whimsicott to tank a super effective hit and follow up with an attack or status infliction.

Rocky Helmet: Whimsicott can utilize its resistances to punish physical attackers that it can handle.

Damage-boosting Items: Items such as Choice Specs and Life Orb give Whimsicott an extra boost in its attacks, allowing it to function as an offensive threat.

Tera

Whimsicott should not be considered to be one of your Tera Captains. Its base typing allows it to take certain attacks, and it doesn't benefit much from changing its typing. If Whimsicott does become a Tera Captain, Tera Ground is good to give it an offensive option for Fire-, Steel-, and Poison-types, and Tera Water and Steel gives it a better defensive typing against its weaknesses.

Draft Strategy

Whimsicott is a good support Pokemon for offensive teams that lack reliable means of handling setup sweepers, and it is able to help enable its stronger teammates. Its reliability will vary depending on the matchup, so it's important to have other tools to work it in case it will be deadweight.

Pivots: Whimsicott can work well with other Pokemon that have access to pivoting to help facilitate momentum. These Pokemon include Tornadus-T, Rotom-W, and Palafin.

Offensive Threats: Whimsicott can help facilitate its offensive teammates, so it's good to draft it alongside Pokemonn like Salamence, Baxcalibur, and Gouging Fire that appreciate any support that can allow them to set up and pressure teams.

Checks and Counters

Fire-, Steel-, and Poison-types: Pokemon such as Gholdengo, Heatran, and Galarian Slowking are able to wall Whimsicott's STAB moves and easily pressure it out with their coverage.

Fast Attackers: Whimsicott is very frail, which leads it to getting easily KOed, especially by faster Pokemon such as Meowscarada, Cinderace, and Iron Bundle.

Mental Herb: Since Encore is one of the main ways for Whimsicott to disrupt its foes, Mental Herb can be a good counter to prevent it from shutting down setup sweepers.

Special Walls: Given that Whimsicott isn't a strong attacker, it can easily be walled by special walls such as Clodsire, Hisuian Goodra, and Tentacruel.

movesets.name: SubSeed
movesets.description:
• Whimsicott can utilize its ability Prankster to go first against most targets such as Dragapult and non-Taunt Spectrier to set up Leech Seed on them while also being able to survive a hit with its decent natural bulk.
  • Moonblast is utilized for the matchup against both Urshifu formes, as usually one or two uses are enough to KO Urshifu-S and Urshifu-R, respectively, while they struggle to KO it back.
  • The combination of Protect and Substitute allows it to stall most Pokemon in the tier thanks to the recovery from Leech Seed; Substitute can also be utilized to give Pokemon like Choice Band Ursaluna and Donphan more chances to miss Gunk Shot, which would otherwise OHKO Whimsicott, allowing it to set up Leech Seed.
  • The HP and Defense EVs allow Whimsicott to survive Choice Band Poison Jab from Urshifu-R thanks to its Kebia Berry, as well as potentially survive any poisoning effects from the same attack, while the Speed EVs are enough to outspeed Adamant variants of both Urshifu formes.
  • Due to the nature of both Leech Seed and Prankster, Whimsicott struggles against most Grass- and Dark-type Pokemon, such as Ogerpon-W, Meowscarada, and Darkrai, and despite the Kebia Berry it holds, it's still not enough to live STAB Poison-type attacks from the likes of Sneasler and Pecharunt, so Pokemon that can beat most of these, such as Scizor, Hisuian Goodra, and Dragapult, make for good partners.
  • It's also worth mentioning that Steel-types like Scizor and Iron Crown can also give big trouble to Whimsicott, so good Steel-type answers like Ursaluna and Landorus-T are good teammates as well.

movesets.name: Utility (Grass)
movesets.description: Whimsicott is a unique and effective pivot option for Grass teams by virtue of its Prankster ability and many viable support moves. U-turn provides Whimsicott with a means to pivot into another teammate in order to maintain momentum. Alternatively, Knock Off can be used over U-turn to take advantage of Encore forcing switches by providing important item removal. The given EV spread makes Whimsicott as fast as possible while maximizing the damage of its Moonblast, letting it 2HKO Mega Sableye and Mandibuzz, and OHKO pokemon like Iron Valiant. Heavy-Duty Boots allows Whimsicott to switch in several times per match without being worn down by entry hazards. Ferrothorn is an excellent partner, since its Steel typing lets it wall Poison- and Steel-type attacks that threaten Whimsicott, and its entry hazards also pair well with Whimsicott's ability to force switches. Celebi is an excellent partner for Whimsicott thanks to its ability to threaten Poison and Steel teams that can make Whimsicott's opportunities to switch in very limited. Ogerpon-C benefits greatly from Whimsicott clearing away hazards so that it can make use of Sturdy to tank a hit it otherwise can't, and it appreciates Encore to help create setup opportunities. A Sunny Day set with Heat Rock can turn Whimsicott into a makeshift sun setter for teams that utilize Chlorophyll sweepers like Venusaur, Hisuian Lilligant, and Scovillain.
